{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Display the age of QA orders
print("QA order rows (revenue = 999999.99):")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'customer_age', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status']])

# Check if any QA orders have customer_age == -1
print("\nAre any QA orders missing age (age == -1)?")
print(qa_orders['customer_age'].eq(-1).any())"}
